meta.title: todolight
meta.description: A shared to-do board where teammates see and help with each other's tasks, all in one screen

me.title: Settings
me.deleteEffectLogin: Your sign-in details, name, email, and profile photo are deleted. You will not be able to sign in again.
me.deleteEffectOwnedOrg: Orgs you own are handed to the longest-standing admin among the remaining members.
me.deleteEffectSoloOrg: Orgs where you are the only member are deleted, along with their to-dos, events, and ledger.
me.deleteEffectRecords: To-dos, notes, and ledger entries you left with your team stay, without your name — your team's books shouldn't change because you left.
